ITEM.PTXT: The "HDD navigation" with built-in back guide monitor computer has been changed to the 09 model year HDD navigation system.
With the adoption of the 09 model year HDD navigation system, service tools are supported and diagnostic codes are output, making it easier to inspect the system in the event of a malfunction.
Installed on the back door outside garnish, it outputs the captured video signal of the area behind the vehicle to the HDD navigation.
Turns the back monitor camera ON/OFF based on signals input from the switches, sensors, etc.
Displays on the display screen the rear image from the back monitor camera and guide lines calculated and predicted based on vehicle status information such as the steering angle signal.
Outputs the shift position "R" signal to the HDD navigation.
Outputs the vehicle speed signal to the "HDD navigation".
Outputs the shift position signal input from the gateway computer to the "HDD navigation".
Performs system diagnosis using the service tool.
Outputs guidance voice when the parallel parking guide mode is selected, using the voice signal from the back guide monitor computer.
The rear view monitor camera consists of an image input section using an ultra-wide-angle lens and an image signal output section consisting of a compact (1/4 inch) color CCD camera.

The image signal output section uses a CCD (Charge Coupled Device) image sensor to convert the image captured (input) by the lens into electrical signals according to light intensity, and outputs them to the back guide monitor computer.

The output image from the rear view monitor camera is itself reversed to match the view when looking rearward in the inner rear view mirror. Therefore, care is required because the image on the screen is shown laterally reversed compared with looking directly rearward (objects on the left side of the vehicle are displayed on the left side of the screen, and objects on the right side of the vehicle on the right side of the screen).
